programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A World of Difference
programmes.d: Businessman Arthur Curtis discovers that life as he knows it doesn't really exist.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Long Live Walter Jameson
programmes.d: Walter Jameson is an excellent history teacher who talks about the past as if he had lived it.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: People Are Alike All Over
programmes.d: When a space exploration crashes on Mars, the surviving passenger is surprised to find that Martians are human-looking, very friendly and apparently just like us...
Just before being hanged for shooting a man in the back, a man in 1880 is transported into the year 1959 by a professor who soon realizes that he has brought forward a savage killer.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Big Tall Wish
programmes.d: An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A Nice Place to Visit
programmes.d: After being shot to death, Rocky Valentine encounters the amiable white-haired Mr. Pip, who gives Rocky everything he wishes for.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare as a Child
programmes.d: Schoolteacher Helen Foley finds a strange and very serious little girl on the stairs outside her apartment. The little girl seems to know her and tries to jog her memory about a man she saw earlier that day. The man arrives at Helen's door…

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A Stop at Willoughby
programmes.d: Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.
A man, desperate to win the affection of a beautiful woman, slips her a love potion. He is overjoyed that the potion works so well...at first.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A Passage for Trumpet
programmes.d: A trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.
An eccentric loser gets a new life from his guardian angel, but there is a price to keeping it.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours
programmes.d: A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!
Den første film fastslog reglerne. I efterfølgeren er indsatsen højere. I tredje film i rækken af hitserien SCREAM kan alt ske. Det er et skrækspil med overraskende drejninger.
Den visionære producer J.J. Abrams ('Lost') og instruktøren Matt Reeves leverer en verdenssensation med åndeløs skræk og spænding, som alle taler om.
Jake bliver dræbt af kvarterets bøller og vender tilbage som en mystisk figur (The Wraith) for at få hævn.
In the near future, gas prices are at an astronomical high. One man is determined to find an alternate fuel source: human blood.
Cupid arrives in the modern world. A love spell for his target does not work as well as he hopes.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: If She Dies
programmes.d: A year after his wife died a man is involved in a car accident that leaves his young daughter in a coma. On his way home the man has a vision.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Welcome to Winfield
programmes.d: A grim reaper tracking a fleeing young man whose soul he is collecting follows the trail to a town seemingly from the Old West.
A compulsive spender accepts "The Card" to keep up her habit. Unfortunately stringent penalties kick in for late payments.
A survivalist traps himself in his bomb shelter when a nuclear blast finally comes.
A modern-day miner has an argument with his wife and then goes off to work in the local mine. A collapse traps him, but he finds another survivor - a miner who claims to be from 1912.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Girl I Married
programmes.d: An attorney and his wife have successful careers. They feel something is lacking in their marriage. Soon, they encounter younger versions of their mates.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Curious Case of Edgar Witherspoon
programmes.d: A woman tries to get her Uncle Edgar committed, believing that he is senile. The investigating doctor finds Edgar living in an apartment containing all kinds of junk.

Ex-baseball player Ed Hamler, lame from an injury and forced to retire early is given a 1909 baseball card of a player that looks exactly like him. The card is magical in that he becomes drawn into it and lives out the life of the player in the past.
A stressed-out priest repeatedly encounters a station wagon containing a young girl. The car keeps crashing and bursting into flames.

A young boy falls into an undiscovered cave near a housing project. An archeologist studies strange paintings on its walls and then bizarre things begin to happen. Cave items move around and animals are killed and brought into the cave.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Dream Me a Life
programmes.d: A man in a retirement home dreams of a woman holding back a monster, and in real life realizes the woman is his cataleptic neighbor.

A hypnotist who specializes in helping people relive their past lives tries to find her own history. She hypnotizes herself and when she awakens, she learns that everyone can now remember their past lives. They also desperately want to forget them.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Hellgramite Method
programmes.d: An alcoholic goes through an extremely painful and potentially deadly cure for his drinking problem. He has to choose which is more important - the bottle or his life.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Our Selina is Dying
programmes.d: A young woman, Debra, comes to live with her mysterious family, including the dying patriarch Selena. After Selena clutches Debra's hand firmly leaving an odd spot on it, Debra begins to age very fast while Selena rejuvenates.

A lonely man accidentally phones the wrong number and finds an intriguing female to whom he grows attached. When she refuses to meet him, he investigates and finds the phone in a museum next to the statue of a woman.
A scam artist purports to channel the spirit of Delos, a former inhabitant of Atlantis. Together with a partner, he makes a living off of it.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Acts of Terror
programmes.d: A woman terrorized by her abusive husband finds some small consolation in a statue of a dog given to her by her sympathetic sister

Newly promoted bank loan officer Warren Cribbens cracks his eyeglasses and discovers he can see the future through them. Faced with seeing the future of the farmers whose farms he must foreclose on, Warren can't bring himself to foreclose.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: There Was an Old Woman
programmes.d: A writer of children's books gives a book to a sick young fan. Later, she starts hearing the sound of children in her house.
A young man at a motel discovers an empty trunk that grants any wishes. He uses it for popularity, but at a party he discovers who his true friends are.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Appointment on route 17
programmes.d: After finishing a heart transplant, a man finds his personality has changed. He also discovers that he has a strange attraction to a waitress at a road diner.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Obsolete Man
programmes.d: In a future totalitarian society, a librarian is declared obsolete and sentenced to death.

A man and a woman, on opposite sides of a future war, encounter each other in a deserted town.
